title: Blocks First
can_do: 面对两个都要完成的任务时，提出一个可行顺序。
trigger: Dad suggests putting the cars away first and the blocks second; Child proposes the reverse order and knows which box holds each group.
setting: Tidying two small toy groups together at home.
essential_props: one toy-cleanup arrangement: two blocks, one red car, one blue car, a blue block box and a red car box

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Dinner's nearly ready. Cars away first, then the blocks.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What if we do blocks first? The blocks are bigger.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Blocks first, then. Which box holds the blocks?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The blue one. The red box is for cars.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Good plan. Put the two blocks in.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Done. Now the cars. I'll take the red one.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: All tidy. Dinner time at last.

replay_cards.title: Coats and shoes
replay_cards.change: Both coat and shoes are needed
replay_cards.challenge: Propose shoes first, then coat; Dad agrees and both steps are completed

replay_cards.title: Books and animals
replay_cards.change: Two groups belong in different places, and Mom initially reverses Child's proposed order
replay_cards.challenge: Child proposes books before animals. When Mom checks animals first, Child repairs, "I mean books first, then animals." Mom accepts the complete order; they shelve the books together, then begin putting the animals away.

parent_support: Keep the real boundary: both toy groups go away. The child may change the order, not cancel a job.
Accept a safe order, finish the first group together, and leave space for the child to initiate the second.
